title: Fair-GPTQ: Bias-Aware Quantization for Large Language Models
findings: The proposed method, Fair-GPTQ, successfully reduces stereotypical bias related to religion in generative question-answering tasks. In evaluations using the BBQ benchmark, Fair-GPTQ showed a significant reduction in bias scores for the 'Religion' category compared to the baseline GPTQ model.
